author: Dr15Jones
body:
#### PR description:

Previously the framework had a whole separate phase for writing Runs and LuminosityBlocks (but not Events). Now the OutputModules just do their writes in the end transitions.

The framework now prefetches all Run and LuminosityBlock products that the OutputModules consume.

#### PR validation:

Code compiles and framework unit tests pass

resolves https://github.com/cms-sw/framework-team/issues/2394
title: Moved run/lumi writing to end transition
